collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IX: REPAIR, FAIRNESS AND MANY FUTURES (LCI-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
From the owner's Volume V concepts (401-500), the 30 themes and the five deeper subjects: old wrongs and their repair, who is heard, prejudice and fairness, care for minds and bodies, animals and hard tradeoffs, inventions and bad inventions, family life, and an island that keeps choosing its own future.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A cheerful singer has withdrawn from everything: sit with them, or ask them to come back.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) used to sing at every gathering. For the last month, (subject.he/she) has not come to any of them. (subject.He/she) works, eats and goes to (subject.his/her) hut. (friend), (subject.his/her) closest friend, does not know what is wrong. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) brings fish and sits by (subject)'s door every evening, without asking anything. Some evenings they talk. Most evenings they do not. After a long while, (subject) hums something, very quietly. It is not a song yet.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks (subject) to come to the next gathering, just to sit. (subject) says not yet. (friend) says that is all right, and keeps asking, gently, every week. One week the answer is yes. (subject) does not sing. (subject.He/she) is there.
